title: Linda
creator: CrossFit
description: Ten descending rounds (10 down to 1) of deadlifts at 1.5× bodyweight, bench presses at bodyweight and squat cleans at 0.75× bodyweight. Known as the Three Bars of Death, it has been programmed since 2003 and takes most people 20 to 30 minutes. Scale the bodyweight multipliers.
